title: Platelet-Related Signature in Colorectal Cancer: Prognosis and Therapy Guidance.
snippet: Platelets are key components of the tumor microenvironment that contribute to colorectal cancer (CRC) progression. However, effective platelet-related prognostic tools for CRC risk stratification and prognostic assessment are lacking. Therefore, we aimed to develop a platelet-related prognostic model to improve risk stratification and prognostic evaluation....
